context: Switching the dataset import endpoint from JSON to a binary format for faster bulk uploads. The file is uploaded by external users.
explanation: pickle.load on an untrusted file allows arbitrary code execution — a crafted pickle payload can run any Python code on the server (e.g. os.system("rm -rf /")). Fix: keep using json.load or another safe deserialization format. If binary performance is needed, use a safe format like MessagePack or Protocol Buffers.
